text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During training with Gold City, she seems in a hurry to improve and change the narrative surrounding her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She meets Tamamo Cross, who admires Gold City's brazen fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross reveals that she's running to support her family. But she has yet to achieve anything of note.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With their shared goal of proving their ability, the two runners promise to face off in a race someday.
